description: This file defines API route handlers for managing orders in a food delivery backend. It includes functions for listing, retrieving, creating, and updating the status of orders, utilizing FastAPI and SQLAlchemy ORM. The routes handle order-related operations such as creating an order from the user's cart, advancing order status, and listing user-specific orders.

methods.name: OrderOut _order_out(order: Order)
methods.description: Converts an Order ORM object into a serializable OrderOut schema for API responses.

methods.name: list[OrderOut] list_orders(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves and lists all orders for the currently authenticated user.

methods.name: OrderOut get_order(order_id: int, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Fetches and returns a specific order owned by the current user, given its ID.

methods.name: CreateOrderResponse create_order(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Creates a new order based on the items in the current user's cart, calculating totals and ensuring all items are from a single active restaurant, then clears the cart.

methods.name: OrderOut advance_status( order_id: int, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Advances the status of a specific order in sequence, used for demo or testing, only callable by the order owner.
